name: pragmatic-launch-strategy
description: Ship now with minimal legal protection, formalize compliance only if traction justifies lawyer costs
steps: Identify minimum viable legal protection (basic disclaimer)
Ship pre-alpha to gauge interest and product-market fit
If traction emerges (>1000 users, revenue, or media attention), formalize legal
Only then: lawyers, full compliance review, entity formation
Pre-traction: focus on product, not legal edge cases
triggers: need to validate before investing in compliance
examples: Add basic README disclaimer, defer full LEGAL.md until traction
Ship shadow analysis feature, monitor before formalizing data retention policies
Use permissive open source license now, formalize IP strategy if commercialized
Everyone ships fast in AI space; worry about lawyers when you have money for lawyers
risks: Potential ToS violations with cloud AI providers
Privacy model gaps could expose user data
mitigations: Keep basic 'use at your own risk' disclaimer in README
Stay under radar (<1000 users) before formalizing
Be prepared to pivot or add compliance if traction hits
Accept that pre-traction legal risk is acceptable cost of validation
